title: Pocket bill scrapbook - Kira
body:
Quick pocket scratchpad (for day-to-day triage).

TODAY TOPS:
- Clear urgent invoices flagged by ops before EOD.
- Draft redline suggestions for Acme Data SOW v3 and send to Maya for AM review.
- Mark any renewal > $50k for revenue ops sync.

INVOICE TRIAGE (ordered by urgency):
1) INV-2026-0102 | OptiScale | $62,400.00 | due 2026-03-15
   - Notes: Q1 reserved cluster consumption. PO matches PO-9901? PO partial; finance asked for tax ID.
   - Action: email ops-contact + attach PO-9901, request tax ID by COB 2026-03-12.

2) INV-2026-0118 | Acme Data | $4,320.00 | due 2026-03-05 (OVERDUE)
   - Small consulting line for model evaluation. Confirm deliverable acceptance in Zendesk ticket #5483.
   - Action: approve for payment once acceptance confirmed; ping product-ops.

3) INV-2026-0124 | NeonCompute | $18,450.00 | due 2026-03-20
   - GPU burst hours. Related to Dedicated pool burst on 2026-02-28.
   - Action: validate burst logs with infra SRE (Rajiv).

CONTRACT REDLINES / SOWS
- Acme Data SOW v3 (deadline: 2026-03-12 internal review)
  - Main ask: tighten data handling sec clause (add: data retained <=90 days; delete broad data-sharing sentence).
  - Payment: prefer 30-day net; vendor requested net45. Suggest net30 with 2% late fee after 15 days.
  - Liability cap: shift from 12 months revenue to explicit $2M cap.
  - Clause snippets to propose: "Redwood Inference shall retain Customer Data for no longer than ninety (90) days following termination of services, unless otherwise required by law."
  - Action: add redline comments in PR-98, ask legal for one-line alternative for data retention.

- Template checklist for quick redlines:
  - Data retention/usage: OK?
  - IP ownership: work-for-hire or license?
  - Liability cap and indemnity: flagged if open-ended.
  - Payment terms and PO reference.
  - Subprocessor list / cross-border data flow.

RENEWALS TO WATCH (flag if >$50k):
- SLA Monitor (third-party observability) - renewal 2026-04-01 - est $72k/year -> flag for AM/Procurement
- Dedicated GPU commit (customer X) - renewal 2026-05-15 - likely >$200k -> sales-led renewal, copy finance ops

QUICK ACTIONS / OUTGOING MESSAGES
- To ops-contact@optiscale: attach PO-9901, confirm tax ID; cc: maya. Subject: OptiScale INV-2026-0102 - PO confirm. (send by 10:30am)
- Zendesk #5483: request acceptance evidence for Acme consulting line. (assign to product-ops)
- Slack: #finance-staff ping Rajiv about NeonCompute burst logs.
- Update PR-98 redline comments and tag @Maya for legal phrase.

PENDING QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF
- Confirm whether PO-9901 covers tax-exempt status (OE number on file?). If yes, mark invoice non-taxable.
- If OptiScale insists on net45, escalate to procurement for one-time approval.
- Keep a trail: always attach matching PO and acceptance evidence before payment.

MISC LOG (brief)
- 2026-03-09 09:14 - called OptiScale AP; left voicemail.
- 2026-03-09 09:40 - Rajiv confirmed burst events log link: s3://billing-exports/neon/2026/02/28.csv (need to fetch).

TODAY PLAN (ordered)
1) Send OptiScale PO request + cc Maya.
2) Zendesk follow-up for Acme acceptance.
3) Draft Acme SOW redlines in PR-98.
4) Quick scan renewal list and flag >$50k items to AM.
5) Log completed items in JIRA-5720 (fin-invoice-triage).

END NOTES:
- Keep this doc as quick daily scratch; once items are resolved, move summary to shared drive under /shared_drives/finance-and-legal/invoice-archive/monthly-2026-03.
- If anything turns risky (payments >$100k with unusual terms), escalate to CFO and legal immediately.

-- Kira 2026-03-10 08:52
